description: This file defines helper functions and constants for handling IAS Zone clusters in a Zigbee device driver context. It includes function declarations for status change handling, resource fetching, registration, and utility functions for zone type names and trouble resources.

methods.name: iasZoneStatusChangedHelper
methods.description: Handles a zone status change event for an IAS Zone in Zigbee.

methods.name: iasZoneFetchInitialResourceValues
methods.description: Fetches initial resource values for an IAS Zone device endpoint.

methods.name: iasZoneRegisterResources
methods.description: Registers zone resources for a device, creating endpoints if necessary.

methods.name: iasZoneHelperGetZoneTypeName
methods.description: Returns a string name for a given zone type value.

methods.name: iasZoneHelperGetTroubleResource
methods.description: Returns the trouble resource name based on device class and zone type name.
